title: Online Evaluation & Reporting
summary: This module provides tools for online evaluation of AI agent runs and function calls, dispatching evaluators asynchronously, and reporting results to various sinks including OpenTelemetry. It also includes utilities for rendering evaluation metrics and durations.

nodes.label: Configure Online Evaluation
nodes.title: OnlineEvalConfig
nodes.description: Defines global and default settings for online evaluation, including sinks, sampling rates, and error handling strategies.

nodes.label: Decorate Functions for Eval
nodes.title: online.wrapper
nodes.description: A decorator that enables online evaluation for any Python function, capturing inputs/outputs and dispatching evaluators asynchronously.

nodes.label: Enable Agent Online Eval
nodes.title: OnlineEvaluation
nodes.description: A capability that integrates online evaluation directly into AI agent runs, dispatching evaluators after each completed agent execution.

nodes.label: Run & Collect Evaluator Results
nodes.title: _run_and_collect
nodes.description: Executes a single online evaluator, manages concurrency, emits OpenTelemetry events, and stashes results for batch submission.

nodes.label: Submit Batched Results to Sink
nodes.title: _submit_group_to_sink
nodes.description: Handles the submission of batched evaluation outcomes to a configured evaluation sink, managing error routing.

nodes.label: Manage OTel Span Context
nodes.title: context_subtree
nodes.description: A context manager for OpenTelemetry spans, allowing the collection and analysis of span trees for evaluation tracing.

nodes.label: Render Numeric Differences
nodes.title: default_render_number_diff
nodes.description: Formats and renders the difference between two numerical values, including absolute and relative changes.

nodes.label: Render Duration Differences
nodes.title: default_render_duration_diff
nodes.description: Formats and renders the difference between two durations, providing clear, human-readable comparisons.

nodes.label: Render Duration
nodes.title: default_render_duration
nodes.description: Formats a given duration in seconds into a human-readable string, adjusting units (microseconds, milliseconds, seconds) as appropriate.

nodes.label: External Evaluator Logic
nodes.title: Evaluator
nodes.description: Represents the core logic of an evaluator, which processes context and produces evaluation results.

nodes.label: Evaluation Result Sink
nodes.title: EvaluationSink
nodes.description: An external destination (e.g., database, logging system) where evaluation results are submitted for storage or further processing.

nodes.label: Agent Run Result
nodes.title: AgentRunResult
nodes.description: The outcome of an AI agent's execution, including its final output, which serves as input for online evaluation.

nodes.label: OpenTelemetry System
nodes.title: OpenTelemetry
nodes.description: An external observability framework used for emitting structured events and traces related to evaluation runs.

groups.label: Surface API
groups.title: User-Facing Integration Points
groups.description: Entry points for integrating online evaluation into functions and AI agents.

groups.label: Evaluation Dispatch & Processing
groups.title: Core Evaluation Logic
groups.description: Components responsible for running evaluators, collecting results, and dispatching them to sinks.

groups.label: Reporting Utilities
groups.title: Metric Rendering for Reports
groups.description: Helper functions for formatting and rendering numerical and duration-based metrics for human-readable reports.

groups.label: Configuration
groups.title: Online Evaluation Settings
groups.description: Defines the configurable parameters and defaults for the online evaluation system.
